text: Leo watched the rain from the window. The drops made a soft tap tap tap sound on the glass. Leo liked the rain because the world got very quiet. He pressed his hand against the cold window. Outside, the flowers were drinking the water and the puddles grew bigger. Leo whispered and drew a little heart in the fog on the window. Then he saw a butterfly hiding under a leaf from the rain. Leo whispered do not worry little one, the rain will stop soon. And it did. And the sun came out gently, like a shy smile.

The world is full of small beautiful things, Mia thought. Quietly, Mia knew that she had found something special.

And from that day, Owen felt a little less scared.

Nora wanted to give Ivy a present, but she was too shy to say it. So Nora made a small paper star all by herself. Nora took a tiny step and left it on Ivy's desk when nobody was looking. Later, Ivy found it and smiled the biggest smile. Ivy looked around the room and saw Nora looking away quietly. Ivy walked over and whispered did you make this? It is beautiful. Nora nodded, feeling her cheeks get warm. Ivy gave Nora a gentle hug. Being shy was okay, because Nora had a gentle heart.

It was bedtime and Ivy was very quiet about the dark. Ivy held a little flower close. Her mom came in and sat on the bed. They whispered a gentle story about a soft cloud. Ivy listened with her eyes getting heavy. The room was warm and safe and quiet. Ivy whispered good night and closed her eyes. The soft glow made everything feel peaceful. Ivy whispered thank you and held the moment in her heart.

Nora watched the rain from the window. The drops made a soft tap tap tap sound on the glass. Nora liked the rain because the world got very quiet. She pressed her hand against the cold window. Outside, the flowers were drinking the water and the puddles grew bigger. Nora slowly reached out and drew a little heart in the fog on the window. Then she saw a kitten hiding under a leaf from the rain. Nora whispered do not worry little one, the rain will stop soon. And it did. And the sun came out gently, like a shy smile.

Ivy had a secret place in the back of the garden. Nobody else knew about it. It was just for Ivy. There, Ivy kept a collection of pretty stones. When Ivy felt soft and careful, she would go to the secret place. She would sit quietly and read. It was like the whole world got small and safe and gentle. After a while, Ivy always felt a little better. Ivy learned that being gentle is a kind of brave.

Finn was a very shy child who was a little scared about many things. Today, Finn wanted to pet the big dog. His heart was beating fast. Finn took a deep breath and counted to three very quietly. Then, very slowly, Finn gently touched its fur. And the dog licked his hand! Finn felt a warm feeling grow inside his chest. It was small, but it was brave. Finn smiled softly and felt warm inside.
